name: Display
author: João Magalhães
description: Brightness and contrast over DDC/CI plus a true gamma exponent and colour temperature on the compositor ramp, with the scale, text size and monitor controls of the built-in Display widget.

barWidget.description: Brightness, contrast, gamma and colour temperature, with scale and text size.

schema.label: Contrast slider (needs a monitor that answers DDC/CI)
Gamma slider, 0.30 to 2.80 (applies to every display)
Colour temperature slider, the night light (every display)
Brightness step when scrolling on the bar (percent)
Refresh interval while the popup is open (seconds)
